cards.ex: Bear in mind that the deadline is next Friday.
cards.exUz: Shuni esda tutingki, oxirgi muddat kelasi juma.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani unutmaslik, doim yodda saqlash kerakligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: His speech gave us a lot of food for thought.
cards.exUz: Uning nutqi bizga o'ylash uchun ko'p sabab berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylantiradigan, muhokama qilishga arziydigan narsa.

cards.ex: I can't get my head around this new software.
cards.exUz: Men bu yangi dasturni tushuna olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir murakkab narsani tushunishga urinmoq.

cards.ex: I have a hunch that he's not telling the truth.
cards.exUz: Men u haqiqatni aytmayotganiga ishonaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa to'g'ri ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilmasdan his qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'm in two minds about whether to go to the party.
cards.exUz: Men partiyaga borish yoki bormaslik haqida ikkilanayapman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishda ikkilanmoq, bir fikrga kelolmaslik.

cards.ex: I lost my train of thought when you interrupted me.
cards.exUz: Siz gapimni bo'lganda, men fikrimni yo'qotdim.
cards.uzDef: Gapirayotgan paytda fikrni unutib qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: His name is on the tip of my tongue.
cards.exUz: Uning ismi tilim uchida turibdi.
cards.term: on the tip of my tongue
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani eslashga harakat qilib, lekin to'liq eslay olmaslik.

cards.ex: Can I pick your brain about this project?
cards.exUz: Men sizdan bu loyiha haqida fikringizni so'rasam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir maslahat yoki ma'lumot olish uchun savollar berish.

cards.ex: That name rings a bell, but I can't place him.
cards.exUz: Bu ism tanish tuyuladi, lekin uni qaerdanligini eslay olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa tanish yoki esda qoladigan bo'lib tuyulmoq.

cards.ex: It completely slipped my mind to call her.
cards.exUz: Unga qo'ng'iroq qilish butunlay esimdan chiqibdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani unutib qo'ymoq, yoddan ko'tarilmoq.

cards.ex: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong.
cards.exUz: Mening ichki sezgim nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Asossiz, lekin kuchli ishonch yoki sezgi.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions before you hear the whole story.
cards.exUz: Butun hikoyani eshitmasdan xulosa qilishga shoshilmang.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni to'liq ko'rib chiqmasdan, shoshilinch xulosaga kelmoq.

cards.ex: She knows this city inside out.
cards.exUz: U bu shaharni mukammal biladi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani juda yaxshi bilmoq, har bir detalini bilmoq.

cards.ex: We had to learn the poem by heart.
cards.exUz: Biz she'rni yod olishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani to'liq yodlab olmoq, xotiraga muhrlamoq.

cards.ex: Have you made up your mind about the job offer?
cards.exUz: Siz ish taklifi haqida qaror qildingizmi?
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qarorga kelmoq, tanlovni amalga oshirmoq.

cards.ex: I think you're missing the point of my argument.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz mening bahsimning ma'nosini tushunmayapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Gapning asosiy mohiyatini, ma'nosini tushunmaslik.

cards.ex: I put two and two together and realized what was happening.
cards.exUz: Men ikkita ikkini qo'shib, nima bo'layotganini angladim.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud ma'lumotlardan xulosa chiqarmoq, voqealarni bog'lamoq.

cards.ex: Let me set the record straight – I never said that.
cards.exUz: Keling, haqiqatni aytay - men hech qachon bunday demaganman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ma'lumotni tuzatmoq, haqiqatni aytmoq.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to solve this problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz ijodiy fikrlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va g'ayrioddiy usullarni o'ylab topmoq, an'anaviy fikrlashdan chetga chiqmoq.

cards.ex: He's a quick study, he'll pick it up in no time.
cards.exUz: U tez o'rganuvchi, u buni tezda o'zlashtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tez va oson o'rgana oladigan odam.

cards.ex: It did cross my mind to quit my job.
cards.exUz: Ishdan bo'shash fikri hayolimdan o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror fikr birdan xayolingizga kelmoq.

cards.ex: I think I get the picture now.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, men hozir vaziyatni tushundim.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni, nima bo'layotganini tushunib yetmoq.

cards.ex: I have a memory like a sieve, I forget everything.
cards.exUz: Mening xotiram past, men hamma narsani unutaman.
cards.term: have a memory like a sieve
cards.uzDef: Yomon xotiraga ega bo'lmoq, tezda unutmoq.

cards.ex: I said some things in the heat of the moment that I regret.
cards.exUz: Men g'azab ostida afsuslangan ba'zi narsalarni aytdim.
cards.term: in the heat of the moment
cards.uzDef: Kuchli his-tuyg'ular ta'sirida, o'ylamasdan qilmoq.

cards.ex: Keep me posted on your progress.
cards.exUz: Meni yutuqlaringizdan xabardor qilib turing.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida yangiliklarni muntazam ravishda xabar berib turmoq.

cards.ex: I almost lost it when he told me the news.
cards.exUz: U menga xabarni aytganda, men deyarli aqldan ozdim.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tuta olmaslik, jahlga erk bermoq, aqldan ozmoq.

cards.ex: Accepting that job offer was a no-brainer.
cards.exUz: Bu ish taklifini qabul qilish oson qaror edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylanishga hojat yo'q bo'lgan, oson qaror.

cards.ex: On second thought, maybe I will come to the party.
cards.exUz: Qaytadan o'ylab ko'rib, ehtimol men partiyaga kelaman.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi fikrni o'zgartirish, qaytadan o'ylab ko'rish.

cards.ex: We don't always see eye to eye on everything.
cards.exUz: Biz har doim ham hamma narsada bir xil fikrda emasmiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lmoq, kelishmovchilik bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: The jury is still out on whether this new treatment will work.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi davolash usuli ish beradimi yoki yo'qmi, hali qaror yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Hali aniq javob yo'q, qaror qabul qilinmagan.
